archetypes.name: dyn-runtime-retirement
archetypes.rationale: Retired runtime reference paths should stay absent without breaking active loaders.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the deleted skills reference files and new harness pins. Check that only audit or contributor docs moved to docs/, and that no active prompt, script, or Python loader still expects the retired skills paths. Pay special attention to negative pins that intentionally mention retired paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-doc-relocation
archetypes.rationale: Moved documentation should preserve marker and legacy audit contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the relocated docs/summary-comment-template.md and docs/attic/dialectic-legacy.md content. Verify marker literals stayed byte-stable, dialectic legacy path references no longer point at nonexistent runtime files, and cross-document links point at the docs copies without implying runtime loading. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
